title: Domestic Pressure Cooker — Specification
scope_summary: This standard covers the requirements for domestic pressure cookers. It does not cover microwaveable pressure cookers.

title: Stationary Storage Type Electric Water Heaters - Specification
scope_summary: Specification for stationary storage type electric water heaters.

title: Household and Similar Electrical Appliances - Safety Part 1 General Requirements
scope_summary: General safety requirements applicable to household and similar electrical appliances, including requirements referred to for storage electric water heaters.

title: Household and Similar Electrical Appliances - Safety Part 2 Particular Requirements Section 21 Storage Water Heaters
scope_summary: Particular safety requirements for storage water heaters, including stationary storage type electric water heaters.

title: Gold and Gold Alloys, Jewellery/Artefacts - Fineness and Marking - Specification
scope_summary: Specifies the fineness grades, gold content requirements, marking requirements and related provisions for gold and gold-alloy jewellery and artefacts.

title: Establishment and Operation of Assaying and Hallmarking Centres - General Requirements
scope_summary: Specifies general requirements for establishment and operation of Assaying and Hallmarking Centres, including infrastructure, personnel, quality management and operational requirements for hallmarking activities.

title: Determination of Gold in Gold Bullion, Gold Alloys and Gold Jewellery/Artefacts - Cupellation (Fire Assay) Method
scope_summary: Specifies the cupellation (fire assay) method for determination of gold in gold bullion, gold alloys and gold jewellery/artefacts.

title: Electric Iron - Specification
scope_summary: Specifies requirements for electric irons intended for domestic use.

title: Household and Similar Electrical Appliances - Safety Part 1 General Requirements
scope_summary: General safety requirements for household and similar electrical appliances, used together with the applicable particular requirements standard.

title: Household and Similar Electrical Appliances - Safety Part 2 Particular Requirements Section 3 Electric Irons
scope_summary: Particular safety requirements for electric irons, used together with the general requirements of IS 302 Part 1.

title: Electric Food-Mixers (Liquidizers and Grinders) and Centrifugal Juicers - Specification
scope_summary: Covers electric motor-driven food-mixers, including liquidizers and grinders, and centrifugal juicers intended for household and similar use and designed for operation at voltages not exceeding 250 V a.c.

title: Household and Similar Electrical Appliances - Safety Part 1 General Requirements
scope_summary: General safety requirements for household and similar electrical appliances, applied together with the relevant particular requirements standard.

title: Household and Similar Electrical Appliances - Safety Part 2 Particular Requirements Section 14 Electric Kitchen Machines
scope_summary: Particular safety requirements for electric kitchen machines, including the applicable requirements referred to for electric food-mixers, liquidizers, grinders and similar kitchen machines.

title: Domestic Gas Stove and Built in Hob for Use with LPG
scope_summary: Specifies requirements for domestic gas stoves and built-in hobs for use with LPG, including applicable construction, burner, gas connection, performance and safety requirements.

title: Domestic and Commercial Equipment for Use with LPG - General Requirements
scope_summary: General requirements for domestic and commercial equipment intended for use with LPG and relevant to LPG-burning appliances.

title: Protective Helmet for Two Wheeler Riders
scope_summary: Specifies requirements for protective helmets intended for riders of two-wheeled motor vehicles, including requirements for construction, materials, retention systems and protective performance.

title: Packaged Drinking Water Other than Packaged Natural Mineral Water - Specification
scope_summary: Specifies requirements for packaged drinking water other than packaged natural mineral water, including applicable quality and safety requirements for water intended for human consumption.

title: Ordinary Portland Cement - Specification
scope_summary: Specifies requirements for Ordinary Portland Cement, including applicable grades and chemical, physical and strength requirements.

title: Pneumatic Tyres for Two and Three Wheeled Motorcycles, Quadricycles and E-Rickshaw/E-Carts
scope_summary: Specifies requirements for pneumatic tyres for two- and three-wheeled motorcycles, quadricycles and e-rickshaw/e-carts.

title: Pneumatic Tyres for Passenger Car Vehicles - Diagonal and Radial Ply
scope_summary: Specifies requirements for diagonal and radial-ply pneumatic tyres intended for passenger car vehicles.

title: Pneumatic Tyres for Commercial Vehicles - Diagonal and Radial Ply
scope_summary: Specifies requirements for diagonal and radial-ply pneumatic tyres intended for commercial vehicles.

title: Switches for Domestic and Similar Purposes - Specification
scope_summary: Covers switches for domestic and similar purposes. The current edition is the Third Revision, with requirements covering ratings, classification, marking, dimensions, protection against access to live parts, earthing, terminals, construction, mechanism, environmental resistance, insulation, electric strength, temperature rise, making and breaking capacity, normal operation and mechanical strength.

title: Self-Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting Services Part 1 Safety Requirements
scope_summary: Specifies general and safety requirements for self-ballasted lamps for general lighting services, including requirements covering cap interchangeability, protection against electric shock, insulation resistance and electric strength, mechanical strength, cap temperature rise, resistance to heat, flame and ignition, fault conditions, creepage distances and clearances, abnormal operation, dimmable lamps and ingress protection.

title: Self-Ballasted LED Lamps for General Lighting Services Part 2 Performance Requirements
scope_summary: Specifies performance requirements for self-ballasted LED lamps for general lighting services, including requirements relating to lamp input power, power factor, harmonics, light output, colour characteristics, lamp life and applicable dimming performance.

title: Safety of Toys Part 1 Safety Aspects Related to Mechanical and Physical Properties
scope_summary: Specifies mechanical and physical safety requirements for toys, including requirements relating to general construction, small parts, sharp points and edges, accessibility, reasonably foreseeable abuse, stability, moving parts, tension and torque, cords and other hazards.

title: Safety of Toys Part 2 Flammability
scope_summary: Specifies flammability requirements for toys and toy materials, including toys worn on the head, toy disguise costumes and toys intended to be worn by children, toys intended to be entered by a child, and soft-filled toys.

title: Safety of Toys Part 3 Migration of Certain Elements
scope_summary: Specifies requirements and test methods for migration of certain elements from toy materials and parts that may be accessible to children, covering the applicable limits for specified toxic elements.

title: Safety of Toys Part 4 Swings, Slides and Similar Activity Toys for Indoor and Outdoor Family Domestic Use
scope_summary: Specifies safety requirements and test methods for swings, slides and similar activity toys intended for indoor and outdoor family domestic use.

title: Safety of Toys Part 9 Certain Phthalates Esters in Toys and Children's Products
scope_summary: Specifies requirements concerning certain phthalates in toys and children's products, including applicable restrictions based on materials and conditions such as intended age and mouthing or other exposure.

title: Welded Low Carbon Steel Cylinders Exceeding 5 Litre Water Capacity for Low Pressure Liquefiable Gases - Part 1 Cylinders for Liquefied Petroleum Gases (LPG) - Specification
scope_summary: Specifies requirements for welded low carbon steel cylinders intended for storage and transportation of liquefied petroleum gases, with nominal water capacity exceeding 5 litres up to and including 250 litres, including requirements for materials, design, manufacture, construction, testing and marking.

title: Welded Low Carbon Steel Cylinders Exceeding 5 Litre Water Capacity for Low Pressure Liquefiable Gases - Methods of Test
scope_summary: Specifies methods of test applicable to welded low carbon steel cylinders covered by the IS 3196 series, supporting testing of cylinders for mechanical, pressure, weld and related conformity requirements.

title: Periodic Inspection and Testing - Welded Low Carbon Steel Cylinders Exceeding 5 Litre Water Capacity for Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) - Code of Practice
scope_summary: Provides requirements and procedures for periodic inspection and testing of welded low carbon steel LPG cylinders during their service life. It is a lifecycle inspection standard rather than the primary standard for initial manufacture and BIS product certification.

title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement
scope_summary: Specifies requirements for high strength deformed steel bars and wires used for concrete reinforcement, including requirements for chemical composition, mechanical properties, dimensions, mass, deformation and surface characteristics, bend and re-bend performance, identification and marking.

title: Electric Ceiling Type Fans - Specification
scope_summary: Specifies requirements for electric ceiling type fans and associated regulators/control arrangements for domestic and similar purposes, including construction, electrical safety, performance, air delivery, speed, power consumption, endurance, regulator requirements and applicable special configurations.

title: Valve Fittings for Use With Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) Cylinders up to and Including 13 Litre Water Capacity - Specification
scope_summary: Specifies requirements for valve fittings used with LPG cylinders up to and including 13 litre water capacity, including material, dimensions, design and testing requirements. Covers Type A valves with parallel inlet threads and Type B valves with bodies directly welded to the cylinder.

title: Valve Fittings for Use with Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) of up to 250 litre Water Capacity - Specification
scope_summary: Specifies requirements for valve fittings for LPG cylinders up to 250 litre water capacity, with applicable requirements for valve design, materials, dimensions and performance. BIS currently lists the standard as the Second Revision with amendments issued in 2018, 2024 and 2025.

title: Portland Pozzolana Cement - Specification: Part 1 Fly Ash Based
scope_summary: Specifies requirements for Portland Pozzolana Cement manufactured using fly ash as the pozzolanic constituent, including requirements for raw materials, chemical composition, physical properties, strength, soundness, setting time and related conformity characteristics.

title: Portland Pozzolana Cement - Specification: Part 2 Calcined Clay Based
scope_summary: Specifies requirements for Portland Pozzolana Cement manufactured using calcined clay as the pozzolanic constituent, including requirements for raw materials, chemical composition, physical properties, strength, soundness, setting time and related conformity characteristics.

title: Household Refrigerating Appliances - Characteristics and Test Methods - Part 1 - General Requirements
scope_summary: Covers general requirements for household and similar refrigerating appliances, including applicable construction, safety and general performance requirements.

title: Household Refrigerating Appliances - Characteristics and Test Methods - Part 2 - Performance Requirements
scope_summary: Specifies performance requirements and associated test methods for household refrigerating appliances, including refrigerators and related refrigerating appliances within its scope.

title: Household Refrigerating Appliances - Characteristics and Methods of Test - Part 3 - Energy Consumption and Volume
scope_summary: Specifies methods for determination of energy consumption and volume of household refrigerating appliances, including energy test conditions and volume determination.

title: Personal Protective Equipment Part 2 Safety Footwear
scope_summary: Specifies basic and additional requirements for safety footwear used for general purposes to protect against specified workplace hazards, including mechanical risks, slips, thermal risks and other applicable hazards.
